This 3-piece baby feeding set combines eco-friendly materials with a charming cartoon bear design, creating an engaging mealtime experience for toddlers aged 1-2 years. Crafted from wheat straw and PP material, the set prioritizes safety and durability for daily feeding routines.

The complete feeding set contains three essential pieces: a 20cm (7.87in) diameter bowl for serving cereals, pasta, and various meals; a 15.5cm x 3.3cm (6.1in x 1.3in) spoon designed for small hands to encourage self-feeding; and a 15.5cm x 2.5cm (6.1in x 0.98in) fork that helps develop fine motor skills. Available in three colors—pink, blue, and beige—to match your child's preferences and nursery decor.

Material & Safety Features

The wheat straw construction offers an eco-friendly alternative to traditional plastic feeding sets. Combined with high-quality PP material, this feeding set ensures durability through countless meals while remaining safe for toddler use. The lightweight design makes it easy for children to handle independently.

Practical Applications

Use this feeding set for everyday breakfast, lunch, and dinner meals. The appealing bear design helps introduce new foods to hesitant eaters, making food exploration less stressful. Perfect for playdates and family gatherings where your toddler can dine alongside others. The set also serves well during snack time for fruits, yogurt, and small bites. Makes a practical gift for baby showers or first birthday celebrations.

Age-Appropriate Design

Specifically sized for toddlers aged 1-2 years, each utensil promotes independence and proper grip development. The spoon and fork dimensions accommodate small hands learning to self-feed, while the bowl's 20cm diameter provides ample space for portion-appropriate meals. The cartoon bear motif captures attention and creates positive mealtime associations.
